runs.review: Decisions were made by the test script, not by a person: keep all but the last listed component (lamp-head), which the script rejects on purpose to exercise the rejection path. The live screenshots therefore show the lamp WITHOUT its luminaire. The same stored plan built whole (replay, no model call) is in runs/replay-street-lamp-desktop and runs/replay-street-lamp-mobile.

geometricProblems: live screenshots: no luminaire (rejected by the script, not the model's omission)

runs.assistantRecognition: Built whole (replay): clearly a street lamp (pole, base, curved outreach arm, luminaire). The live screenshots without the luminaire read as a pole with a bent arm.

chambers are ellipsoids; valves and septum are not modelled (valve-rings was rejected by the script)
runs.assistantRecognition: a schematic heart: two large chambers, aorta arch and great vessels are recognisable; it is a stylised concept, not anatomy

harnessNote: The e2e script's automatic rejection of the last component is a test-harness behaviour. It was applied to both live runs before I noticed it contaminated the evidence; it is now limited to the labelled fixture.
